P-mail (Printed Matter) The service rate is 160yen per mail, and 50yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 160yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 50yen
P-mail (Small Packets) The service rate is 250yen per mail, and 50yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 250yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 50yen
